u2a.ambiguity: several plausible readings of what you ask
u2a.context_gap: missing where: repo, file, ticket or error
u2a.explanation_gap: little motive or background for the request

a2u.ambiguity: answer can be read more than one way
a2u.idea_branching: too many nested branches or lists
a2u.context_gap: missing context to act on the answer
a2u.opacity: intent of the answer hard to see

error.no_home: cannot determine the user home directory

log.no_turn: no open turn (UserPromptSubmit hook not installed or turn already closed)
log.tip_long: --tip has {n} characters (max {max}): one short, direct action, no examples

report.reserved_filters: warning: keyword/repo filters reserved for compatibility
report.title: Linguistic nebulosity report
report.export_collision: too many files use the generated name
report.recommendations_missing: No recommendations: they are written by the model from the latest turns (pass --recs).
report.recommendations_invalid: --recs must be JSON or a JSON file: {error}
report.intro_what: **What it measures.** Linguistic nebulosity is the lack of clarity, precision or transparency that makes a text hard to understand. Higher is worse.
report.intro_directions: **Two directions.** **u2a** (user to assistant): your prompts as I receive them. **a2u** (assistant to user): my answers as you read them.
report.read_trend: *Trend*: first half of the turns against the second half; a drop is an improvement.
report.read_heuristic: *Heuristic (h)*: automatic text-rule score, used as a contrast to expose bias in my self-scoring.
report.read_bias: *Bias*: my score minus the heuristic; negative means I score lower (kinder) than the rules.
report.volume: **Volume:** {turns} turns in {sessions} sessions, {real} real time, median turn {median}, estimate ratio {ratio}.
report.usage: **Usage:** {requests} requests, {agents} agents, {words_in} words from you against {words_out} from me.
report.trend_short: **Trend:** not enough turns to compare halves.
report.keyword_none: No keywords recorded for these turns.
report.opportunity_improving: weak but already improving: {items}; keep the pressure on them
report.opportunity_momentum: biggest gain so far: {metric} ({first} → {second}); the same habit can lift the rest
report.threat_corrections: {count} corrections recorded; weak areas raise the risk of misreading
report.threat_bias_u2a: I score your prompts below the heuristic on {items}; the real value is likely higher
report.threat_bias_a2u: I score myself below the heuristic on {items}; the real value is likely higher

tips.window: window: latest {k} of {n} scored turns in this conversation ({pct}%) against the earlier ones
tips.window_all: window: latest {k} of {n} scored turns ({pct}%) against the turns before them
tips.overall: average of the 10 sub-metrics: window {w} · before {b}
tips.gate_on: this turn's u2a {now} is worse than the conversation baseline {base}: write a tip
tips.gate_off: this turn's u2a {now} is not worse than the conversation baseline {base}: no tip shown

estimate.none: no historical turns match these keywords

data.confirmation: refusing to delete Nebula data without --yes

learning.calibrate_header: metric                 dir  n    corr   slope  intercept  mean bias
learning.fit_header: metric                 dir  n    rule r  CV r          lambda  adopted
learning.fit_done: adopted {count} learned models; heuristic values recomputed; calibration reset

import.invalid_turn: score row {row} has no integer turn_id
import.invalid_keywords: score row {row} keywords must be an array of strings
import.invalid_task_type: score row {row} task_type must be text
import.invalid_clarifying: score row {row} clarifying_questions must be a non-negative number
import.ambiguous_host: cannot determine one transcript host; pass --host claude|codex or set NEBULA_TRANSCRIPTS
